prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, pickup and analyse it. Otherwise approach object or scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = PickupObject    /> <Action ID = AnalyseObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <SubTree ID = AnalyseObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO PickupObject
	ELSE
		DO AnalyseObject
	END
